{{Current events|year=2026|month=07|day=18|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Iranian strikes on Arab countries]]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Bahrain]]
****The [[Bahrain Defence Force|Bahraini military]] intercepts projectiles fired from [[Iran]]. [https://www.yahoo.com/news/world/articles/iranian-attack-hits-kuwaiti-power-113332751.html (DPA via Yahoo News)]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Jordan]]
****The [[United States Central Command|U.S. Central ​Command]] (CENTCOM) reports that two [[United States Armed Forces|American troops]] have been "[[killed in action]]" in [[Jordan]], bringing the [[Casualties of the 2026 Iran war|total casualties]] for American troops to 16. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/two-us-service-members-jordan-killed-iranian-attack-us-says-2026-07-18/ (Reuters)] [https://www.wsj.com/world/middle-east/two-u-s-servicemembers-killed-one-missing-in-iran-missile-attack-on-jordan-a59f9699 (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Kuwait]]
****[[Kuwait]] says Iranian attacks have struck a second [[Energy in Kuwait|power]] and [[Desalination in Kuwait|desalination plant]] in two days, causing a fire and shutting several generating units, while other attacks injure firefighters and a worker and temporarily disrupt flights from [[Kuwait International Airport]]. [https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/07/kuwait-says-iran-hit-second-power-water-plant/ (AFP via ''Vanguard'')]
****An [[oil]] facility is damaged, according to the [[Kuwait Petroleum Corporation]]. [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/iran-says-it-is-suspending-commitments-to-interim-deal-with-u-s-as-they-exchange-attacks (PBS)]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Saudi Arabia]]
****''[[Axios (website)|Axios]]'' reports that Iran has launched a [[Ballistic missile program of Iran|ballistic missile]] at a [[United States]] base in [[Saudi Arabia]], making it the first direct attack by Iran on the country since targeting a [[petrochemical]] complex in [[Jubail]]. [https://www.ft.com/content/e8e8adc5-7c56-45a8-99fc-bb5acfda263e?syn-25a6b1a6=1 (''Financial Times'')]
**[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
***[[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian deputy foreign minister]] [[Kazem Gharibabadi]] says that the United States has violated the terms of the [[Islamabad Memorandum]] and that Iran is "no longer implementing them". [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/iran-says-it-is-suspending-commitments-to-interim-deal-with-u-s-as-they-exchange-attacks (PBS)]
**[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
***The [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]], in a statement published by [[Islamic Republic News Agency|IRNA]], report that two [[oil tanker|oil tankers]] have exploded after hitting [[Naval mine|mines]] south in the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. However, the [[United States Central Command|U.S. Central Command]] disputes the claims on [[X (social network)|X]] as "false". [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2651361/middle-east (AFP via ''Arab News'')]
***The [[Department of Foreign Affairs (Philippines)|Philippine foreign affairs department]] reports that four [[Philippines|Philippine]]-registered vessels carrying 81 seafarers have safely transited through the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. The vessels are identified as the MV ''Lyng Trader'', MV ''Western Doncaster'', MV ''Vivian Trader'', and MV ''Eva Fuji''. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/pinoyabroad/dispatch/995339/filipino-seafarers-strait-hormuz/story/ (GMA Network)]
**[[July 2026 United States strikes against Iran]]
***In the seventh day of renewed U.S. strikes, civilian infrastructure, including a [[desalination]] plant in [[Jask]], are damaged, cutting off the [[Water supply and sanitation in Iran|access to water]] for 10,000 civilians. [https://en.irna.ir/news/86212664/Emergency-water-supply-to-affected-villages-in-Jask-begins-Governor (IRNA)] [https://www.bbc.com/persian/articles/cd7lx02wjn8o (BBC Persian <small>(in Persian)</small>)]
***[[Telecommunications in Iran|Communications]] services in Iran's [[Hormozgan province]] are disrupted after U.S. strikes damaged 116 [[radio towers]] there. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy748n8zx8ro (BBC News)] [https://www.bbc.com/persian/live/c8rnde80d86t (BBC Persian <small>(in Persian)</small>)]
***The U.S. CENTCOM launches a new wave of strikes for an eighth consecutive night against IRGC targets in response to two American service members killed in Jordan. [https://thehill.com/homenews/5976478-us-strikes-iran-retaliation/ (''The Hill'')]
*[[Mali War]]
**[[2026 Mali offensives]]
***The [[Al-Qaeda]]-linked [[Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin]] and [[Tuareg people|Tuareg]] [[Azawad Liberation Front]] rebels ambush a [[Malian Armed Forces|Malian military]] convoy in the [[Gao Region]] of [[Mali]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/18/armed-groups-attack-malian-military-convoy-in-gao-region (Al Jazeera)] [https://apnews.com/article/mali-rebels-soldiers-killed-captured-d10c035668be0eaf9174db4c89eca90b (AP)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war]], [[Aerial warfare in the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Moscow Oblast]] [[Governor of Moscow Oblast|governor]] [[Andrey Vorobyov]] and [[Tambov Oblast]] [[Head of Tambov Oblast|head]] [[Yevgeny Pervyshov]] say [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[Drone warfare|drone attacks]] killed seven workers and injure 49 others at [[Wildberries]] warehouses in [[Kotovsk, Russia|Kotovsk]] and [[Elektrostal]], [[Russia]], while another strike ignites an [[Oil in Russia|oil facility]]. Ukraine says the warehouses support [[Unmanned Systems Forces of Russia|Russian drone]] production. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukrainian-drone-attacks-kill-seven-warehouse-workers-russia-spark-fire-moscow-2026-07-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Arab League]] [[Secretary General of the Arab League|secretary general]] [[Nabil Fahmy]] and [[Senior Advisor to the President of the United States|U.S. envoy]] [[Massad Boulos]] reach an agreement to establish a regular framework for joint coordination for a [[ceasefire]] in the ongoing [[civil war]] in [[Sudan]]. [https://sudantribune.com/article/316368 (''Sudan Tribune'')]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**An insurgent is killed and five others are injured during a counterterrorism operation that foiled a [[Terrorism in Pakistan|terrorist]] plot in [[Wana, Pakistan|Wana]], [[South Waziristan]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.dawn.com/news/2016455/terrorist-killed-as-security-forces-destroy-explosive-laden-vehicle-intended-for-suicide-attack-in-wana-state-media (''Dawn'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Belgium–Israel relations]], [[International reactions to the Gaza war]]
**[[Belgium]] approves an [[import ban]] on goods from [[Israeli settlements]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/18/belgium-bans-imports-from-israeli-settlements-in-occupied-palestine (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[Kuwait Airways]] reschedules most of its flights due to the country's airspace being closed amidst ongoing Iranian attacks. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/live-blog-update/kuwait-airways-says-most-flights-rescheduled-airspace-closed (''Middle East Eye'')]
**Iran's [[Hormozgan province]] water and wastewater company announces that United States [[airstrike]]s have damaged [[desalination]] equipment, cutting off water to about 10,000 people. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/us-strikes-leave-10000-iranians-without-water-kuwait-desalination-plant-burns (''Middle East Eye'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Krokstadelva fire]]
**Over 100 houses burn down in a fire in the [[Krokstadelva]] municipality of [[Norway]]. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2623536-in-beeld-dit-is-de-ravage-na-de-enorme-brand-in-noorse-stad-krokstadelva (NOS)]
*Nine people are killed and nine others are injured after an unauthorized [[firecracker]] factory explodes in [[Ahmedabad]], [[Gujarat]], [[India]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/8-killed-9-injured-in-blast-inside-illegal-ahmedabad-firecracker-factory-11788790 (NDTV)] [https://english.news.cn/20260719/56ff57ffcbf343c3b405b462301bf3c8/c.html (Xinhua)]
*Five people are killed and two others are injured in a workplace accident in [[Thanh Hóa province]], [[Vietnam]]. [https://english.news.cn/asiapacific/20260719/65158f04101647f2ac931182f996c1ab/c.html (Xinhua)]
*Five people, including three women, drown in the [[Godavari River]] whilst fishing near [[Polavaram district]], [[India]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/andhra-pradesh/five-persons-including-three-women-drowned-in-godavari-river-while-fishing-in-polavaram-district/article71237484.ece (''The Hindu'')]
*Four people are killed, four more are missing, and seven others are injured after torrential rains and [[flash flood]]s hit a mountainous village in [[Lai Châu province]], [[Vietnam]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/torrential-rains-kill-4-in-vietnam-/4002084 (AA)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Turkey–Islamic State conflict]]
**[[Turkey]]'s [[Ministry of Interior (Turkey)|interior ministry]] announces the arrest of 119 people linked to [[Islamic State|ISIS]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/amp/News/middle-east/2026/07/18/turkey-arrests-119-accused-of-links-to-isis (AFP via Al Arabiya)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Magyar Government]]
**[[Hungary|Hungarian]] [[President of Hungary|president]] [[Tamás Sulyok]] signs the 17th [[constitutional amendment|amendment]] to the nation's [[Fundamental Law of Hungary|constitution]], which will end his term in office at [[midnight]] the following day. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cpd7q7eev7po (BBC News)]
*[[Jens Spahn]] resigns as leader of [[Merz cabinet|the governing]] [[CDU/CSU]] alliance in [[Germany]]'s [[Bundestag]] amid criticism after he and [[Daniel Funke|his husband]] became parents through [[surrogacy]], despite [[Surrogacy laws by country#Germany|Germany's ban]] and [[Christian Democratic Union of Germany|his party]]'s opposition to the practice. [https://www.channelstv.com/2026/07/18/german-lawmaker-steps-down-for-using-us-surrogacy-to-have-a-child/ (AFP via Channels TV)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Space industry of India]]
**[[Skyroot Aerospace]] successfully launches [[Vikram-1]], [[India]]'s first [[Private spaceflight|privately]] built [[orbital rocket]], from the [[Satish Dhawan Space Centre]] in [[Andhra Pradesh]], carrying small satellite payloads into [[low Earth orbit]] on its maiden flight. [https://english.aawsat.com/varieties/5297323-india-successfully-launches-1st-private-orbital-rocket (AFP via ''Asharq Al-Awsat'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2026 FIFA World Cup]]
**In [[association football]], [[England national football team|England]] beats [[France national football team|France]] 6–4 in the highest-scoring [[2026 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#Match for third place|third-place playoff]] in [[FIFA World Cup]] history, securing their best result since winning the tournament in [[1966 FIFA World Cup|1966]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/cly5lj1nqdxt (BBC Sport)]
**French footballer [[Kylian Mbappé]] scores twice to become [[List of FIFA World Cup top goalscorers|the highest-scoring player in World Cup history]], and the first player to score 10 goals in a single World Cup since [[Germany national football team|Germany]]'s [[Gerd Müller]] in [[1970 FIFA World Cup|1970]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/live/cly5lj1nqdxt (BBC Sport)]
*[[2026 Diamond League]]
**At the [[2026 London Athletics Meet|London Athletics Meet]], British runner [[Josh Kerr (runner)|Josh Kerr]] sets a [[Mile run world record progression|new world record]] of 3:42.66 for the [[Mile run|mile]]. The previous record of 3:43.13 by [[Hicham El Guerrouj]] had been set in 1999. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/athletics/articles/cx2jl1wge2po (BBC Sport)]
